7.4 Multi Partition Support
For multiple BswM instances, each BswM instance will generate its own separate ser-
vice component description based on its own config set. The integrator will need to
allocate these separate service components to the corresponding partition.
[SWS_BswM_00320] Partition Local Action Lists
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_02003
⌈BswM is present in each partition with a partition specific configuration (separate in-
stance of BswMConfig per partition). The contained action lists are executed partition
locally.⌋
